sections.title: Which one, by number
sections.content: hányas ("which number, what number") is the question word for anything identified by a number — bus lines, tram lines, house numbers. Hányas villamossal mész? ("Which-numbered tram do you take?") It behaves like an ordinary adjective, taking whatever case the noun needs: hányas villamosra (onto which tram), hányas villamosról (off which tram).

items.english: Which bus (number) are you coming on?

sections.content: Don't confuse hányas with hány ("how many") — hány asks for a count, hányas asks which one, by number.
